stories.summary: Fix AI Service Dependency Conflicts & Python 3.12 Compatibility

details.user_story: As a developer, I want a clean and compatible requirements.txt for the AI Service so that I can install dependencies without version conflicts or Python compatibility errors.
details.context: The AI Service (Service 1) runs on Python 3.12. The previous configuration caused build failures due to a version mismatch in `mediapipe` (which required an older Python version) and a critical conflict between `opencv-python` and `opencv-python-headless`.
acceptance_criteria: Update `requirements.txt` to use `mediapipe==0.10.14` for Python 3.12 compatibility.
Remove `opencv-python` (full) to resolve namespace collisions with `opencv-python-headless`.
Verify the service starts and the `/health` endpoint returns a 200 OK status.
details.technical_details: Modified `requirements.txt` to unpin `protobuf` (allowing resolution) and removed the GUI-dependent OpenCV library. Verified via `pip check` and `uvicorn` startup.
edge_cases: Local environments may require `pip uninstall opencv-python` to clear out residual files from the conflicting installation.
